 Venezia and Udinese meet in a crucial Serie A clash this Friday, 6 November, at 19:45 local time, at the Stadio Pierluigi Penzo in Venice.
 Both sides are struggling near the bottom of the table, with Venezia rooted to 20th place and Udinese only two points above them. The visitors have also lost seven of their last eight league matches, while the hosts are coming off three consecutive defeats without scoring.
 Read on for our analysis of the match, sports betting tips, and the players expected to feature in the starting line-ups.

 Venezia vs. Udinese - Head-to-head record
 Udinese have had the upper hand in this fixture , winning five of the last seven league meetings between the sides. They also came out on top in their Coppa Italia encounter earlier this season, beating Venezia 2-1.
 The visitors’ historical advantage is less pronounced at the Stadio Pierluigi Penzo, where they have managed only one top-flight victory. Venezia will therefore hope their home advantage can help them reverse the recent trend.
 The two teams have not drawn any of their last five meetings, while Udinese’s recent victories have generally been competitive rather than one-sided. With both clubs desperate for points, another closely contested encounter could be in store.

 Venezia - In desperate need of points
 Here is a closer look at Venezia’s current situation. We will analyse the team’s poor run of form, their recent results, and how they might approach this upcoming test against Udinese.
 Recent form
 Venezia have collected just three points from their first 10 league matches, winning once and losing nine . They have scored only six goals and conceded 20, leaving them firmly in the relegation zone.
 After beating Napoli 1-0 in Nicola’s first match in charge, the Lagunari have lost their next three fixtures without scoring. Their latest setback was a 1-0 defeat away to Como, despite a busy performance from goalkeeper Filip Stankovic.
 The hosts will be without Marin Sverko, Bartol Franjic and Andrea Adorante, while Thierry Correia is struggling with a thigh injury. Lion Lauerbach has started the last two matches, but John Yeboah could return to the attack to partner Akor Adams, who has scored twice in Serie A this season.

 Udinese - Struggling for positive results
 Let’s take a look at Udinese’s current situation. We will analyse the team’s momentum, their expectations, and standout performers for the trip to Venezia.
 Recent form
 Udinese have collected just five points from 10 Serie A matches, their worst start to a season this century . Their latest result was a heavy 5-2 home defeat to Roma, which marked Runjaic’s final match in charge.
 The visitors have struggled at both ends of the pitch, with their only recent positive result a goalless draw against Parma. They have also lost to Cagliari, Torino, Lecce and AC Milan in their last five league fixtures.
 Zanetti takes charge against his former club, with the opportunity to lift Udinese away from the relegation zone. Alessandro Zanoli, David Alaba and Idrissa Gueye are unavailable, while Vakoun Bayo remains a doubt. Oumar Solet has recovered from a calf problem and could return to the defence.

 The last five encounters between Venezia and Udinese have produced an average of 3.8 goals per match.
 Both teams have found the back of the net in four of their last five head-to-head clashes.
 Udinese have struggled defensively this season, conceding an average of 2.3 goals per game in Serie A.
 For Venezia, midfielder Gianluca Busio has been a creative spark, providing two assists in only six appearances.
 Udinese’s defender Hassane Kamara poses a threat, contributing two goals and two assists from the back.

 Predictions for Venezia vs. Udinese - Goals and a decisive result
 Both teams are struggling for form, making this a crucial relegation six-pointer where a winner seems inevitable. Considering there has not been a draw in their last five meetings, a “Double Chance 12” bet is an appealing option.
 With both defences looking vulnerable throughout this season, goals are certainly anticipated at the Stadio Pierluigi Penzo. We expect an early breakthrough in the action, making a bet on over 0.5 goals in the first half a strong possibility.
 Combining the historical trend for decisive results and both teams’ current defensive frailties, our main prediction is for either team to win and over 2.5 goals .
